additional_info.subject: ID0435866-DC/Si-D/SA-[MP / N0 170000001] Charger not working CRM:00642002390
additional_info.body:
Hello Sadek,
Hope you are doing great.
We have received a case from an end customer reporting that the charger is offline. As a first step, we have requested a hard reboot of the charger from the site.
If the reboot does not resolve the issue, a site visit will be necessary to investigate further.
Unfortunately, we cannot do much remotely when we don't have SCB connection.
The best would be to have someone on site to check:
Local reboots help to bring the charger back online.
If the router is connected to internet
If the charger is powered
Then we can analysis the log to try to find out why outlets are offline.
And kindly refer the below points which might be the reason to out the charger on SCB.
Then there might be Internet issue with the Siemens router and probably because of failover function the WAN is switched from Cellular to Ethernet.
I would recommend doing a Hard reset from "OCPP" (If charger is connected to OCPP server) or a local reboot will bring them up again.
data service of mobile network operator might not be available
- SIM card disabled / expired
- monthly data volume exhausted
- signal strength got weak due to changed radio transmission conditions
- in case of M2M contracts is IP not enabled
Backend related issues
- Backend changed the settings for the affected charger
- OCPP server on Backend side unavailable
Teltonika related issues
- Router switches to a wrong network service (e.g. 3G instead of 4G)
- Hardware failure of Router
- Router software crash

additional_info.subject: 0435866 - ID0435866-DC/Si-D/SA-[MP / N0 170000001] Charger not working CRM:00314000230
additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0435866.
I checked the ticket and the charger today, and:
As previously mentioned in the ticket, charger is out of order, hence Expert support needs to be ordered.
Charger is offline on SCB, but it is logging, showing signs of FW corruption:
Therefore, the activity necessary is to flash the CFast card and restore the charger. To complete the activity, we will need to:
Flash the CFast card
Flash the USB live linux stick
Re-commission the charger and check router integrity.
To perform the above mentioned activities, we will need the following tools:
CFast card reader:
https://www.conrad.de/de/p/transcend-rdf2-externer-speicherkartenleser-usb-3-1-gen-1-schwarz-1421336.html?hk=SEM&gclid=EAIaIQobChMIlLTv4Nbe-AIVchoGAB3ESQvAEAAYASAAEgJJSvD_BwE
USB stick with 64GB
Keyboard with USB connection
Companion Tool.
For the activity, I forecast:
Up to 3 hours of office preparation activity. Download of the FW required and flashing of FWs
Up to 3 hours to recommission the charger and complete troubleshooting activities.
Please let me know if the external partner is already in possess of a USB Live Linux stick or not. Due to data confidentiality, the Live Linux image cannot be shared with externals, but it can be set it up with Siemens colleagues, and then the already flashed USB stick will be shipped to the external party. Please consider also this step in the activity forecasted.
Since it is an out of warranty case which requires expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com

.
